data.title: Islamic Affairs Ministry Provides Awareness Services to over 300,000 Umrah Performers in Makkah
data.content:
Riyadh, November 23, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance continues to implement its religious guidance and awareness programs in mosques across the central area of Makkah, aiming to educate Umrah performers about the rulings governing the rituals and strengthen their understanding of the tolerant teachings of Islam.
    A total of 9,172 religious guidance activities have been conducted since the beginning of the Umrah season through the end of Jumada Al-Awwal 1448 AH, benefiting more than 300,000 people.
    The activities included 3,486 religious sermons, 1,136 lessons and lectures, and 4,550 activities dedicated to answering Umrah performers' questions and religious inquiries.
    The programs are delivered by specialized preachers, with the assistance of translators to facilitate the delivery of awareness messages to Umrah performers of different nationalities and linguistic backgrounds.
    -- SPA
